name: QCon London 2027
description: Practitioner software conference with strong architecture and AI tracks
place: The Queen Elizabeth II Conference Centre
note: Conference, English; early bird until 10 Nov 2026; optional certification day 16 Apr
details: Three conference days with 15 tracks (incl. Architecture in the Age of AI, AI & ML, Cloud & Platform Engineering) and 75+ practitioner speakers, plus an optional InfoQ Certified Architect day on 16 April. 3-day ticket 2,390 GBP on the official page, early bird deadline 10 November; a video-only pass exists. Recordings available for 12 months. Attendee count not stated (roughly 800+ inferred from the speaker ratio).
